key.name: engine
key.description: Name or path of the phonecam command. Empty means the copy that ships in the extension directory.

key.name: setup
key.description: Name or path of the phonecam-setup command. Empty means the copy that ships in the extension directory.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Time between two reads of the state of the stream, in seconds. The widget reads each second for 12 seconds after an action.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts and stops the stream. More than one value means more than one shortcut.
